results.question: 2026年1月至6月，福田分公司每个月累计产销差率较上月的环比变化是多少？
value_fields: 累计产销差率环比变化
results.sql:
SELECT CAST(_g."月份(期数)" AS int) AS "月份(期数)", ROUND((_g.rate)::numeric, 4) AS "累计产销差率", ROUND((_g.mom_change)::numeric, 4) AS "累计产销差率环比变化"
FROM (
SELECT ym AS "月份(期数)", rate, rate - prev_rate AS mom_change
FROM (
  SELECT ym, rate, LAG(rate) OVER (ORDER BY ym) AS prev_rate
  FROM (
    SELECT f.businessyearmonth AS ym, (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate
    FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
    WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth IN (202601,202602,202603,202604,202605,202606) AND f.zoneid='F1004'
    GROUP BY f.businessyearmonth
  ) a
) s
ORDER BY 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY 1 ASC
evidence: 6 期累计率与环比全部命中标准值。
率尺度为 0–1，与标准值一致。

results.question: 2026年1月至5月，盐田分公司每个月的供水量、售水量和产销差水量分别是多少？
results.sql:
SELECT CAST(_g."月份(期数)" AS int) AS "月份(期数)", ROUND((_g.supply)::numeric, 4) AS "供水量", ROUND((_g.sales)::numeric, 4) AS "售水量", ROUND((_g.diff_vol)::numeric, 4) AS "产销差量"
FROM (
SELECT f.businessyearmonth AS "月份(期数)", SUM(f.totalproduct) AS supply,
       SUM(f.totalconsume) AS sales, SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume) AS diff_vol
FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusiness' AND f.businessyearmonth IN (202601,202602,202603,202604,202605) AND f.zoneid='F1001'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY 1 ASC
results.root_cause: CLI 的 month_product / month_consume 用 SzwgBusinessYear 年累计相减得到当月值；标准值用 dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx 的 SzwgBusiness 单月快照。前 3 个月两套值恰好相等，202604 起累计口径被修订，差异暴露。
results.recommendation: 统一「当月水量」口径：要么 CLI 直接暴露 SzwgBusiness 单月值，要么标准集改用 SzwgBusinessYear 累计差并重新业务确认。在口径定稿前，不要把 month_* 当成唯一当月来源。
evidence: 验证：year_cum_product(202605)-year_cum_product(202604)=2498583，与 CLI 完全一致

results.question: 2026年1月至5月，全集团各单位的年累计产销差率月度趋势是怎样的？
results.actual_text: 返回 15 个单位，314 行
results.sql:
SELECT _g."组织" AS "组织", ROUND((_g.jan)::numeric, 4) AS "1月", ROUND((_g.feb)::numeric, 4) AS "2月", ROUND((_g.mar)::numeric, 4) AS "3月", ROUND((_g.apr)::numeric, 4) AS "4月", ROUND((_g.may)::numeric, 4) AS "5月"
FROM (
SELECT "组织", jan, feb, mar, apr, may FROM (
  SELECT 
CASE t.zoneid WHEN 'F1' THEN '深圳环境水务集团'
     WHEN 'F100' THEN '集团本部'
     WHEN 'F1001' THEN '盐田分公司'
     WHEN 'F1002' THEN '罗湖分公司' WHEN 'F1004' THEN '福田分公司' WHEN 'F1003' THEN '南山分公司'
     WHEN 'F1007' THEN '宝安水务集团' WHEN 'F1501' THEN '龙岗水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1500' THEN '龙华水务集团' WHEN 'F1005' THEN '光明水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1012' THEN '大鹏新区分公司' WHEN 'F1014' THEN '布吉水司'
     WHEN 'F1013' THEN '莲塘供水' WHEN 'F1009' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN 'F1011' THEN '深汕水务'
     ELSE t.zoneid END AS "组织", MAX(CASE WHEN t.businessyearmonth=CAST(202601 AS int) THEN t.rate END) AS jan,
       MAX(CASE WHEN t.businessyearmonth=CAST(202602 AS int) THEN t.rate END) AS feb,
       MAX(CASE WHEN t.businessyearmonth=CAST(202603 AS int) THEN t.rate END) AS mar,
       MAX(CASE WHEN t.businessyearmonth=CAST(202604 AS int) THEN t.rate END) AS apr,
       MAX(CASE WHEN t.businessyearmonth=CAST(202605 AS int) THEN t.rate END) AS may
  FROM (
    SELECT f.zoneid, f.businessyearmonth, (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate
    FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
    WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth IN (202601,202602,202603,202604,202605)
    GROUP BY f.zoneid, f.businessyearmonth
  ) t
  GROUP BY t.zoneid
) x
UNION ALL
SELECT '集团合计' AS "组织", jan, feb, mar, apr, may FROM (
  SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN g.businessyearmonth=CAST(202601 AS int) THEN g.rate END) AS jan,
       MAX(CASE WHEN g.businessyearmonth=CAST(202602 AS int) THEN g.rate END) AS feb,
       MAX(CASE WHEN g.businessyearmonth=CAST(202603 AS int) THEN g.rate END) AS mar,
       MAX(CASE WHEN g.businessyearmonth=CAST(202604 AS int) THEN g.rate END) AS apr,
       MAX(CASE WHEN g.businessyearmonth=CAST(202605 AS int) THEN g.rate END) AS may
  FROM (
    SELECT f.businessyearmonth, (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate
    FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
    WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth IN (202601,202602,202603,202604,202605)
      AND f.zoneid IN ('F1001','F1002','F1004','F1003','F1007','F1501','F1005','F1500','F1013','F1009','F1012','F1011')
    GROUP BY f.businessyearmonth
  ) g
) y
ORDER BY 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY 1 ASC

results.question: 2026上半年各单位的年累计产销差率较2025上半年同比变化是多少？
results.sql:
SELECT _g."组织" AS "组织", ROUND((_g.rate_2026)::numeric, 4) AS "2026上半年产销差率", ROUND((_g.rate_2025)::numeric, 4) AS "2025上半年产销差率", ROUND((_g.yoy_change)::numeric, 4) AS "同比变化"
FROM (
SELECT 
CASE f.zoneid WHEN 'F1' THEN '深圳环境水务集团'
     WHEN 'F100' THEN '集团本部'
     WHEN 'F1001' THEN '盐田分公司'
     WHEN 'F1002' THEN '罗湖分公司' WHEN 'F1004' THEN '福田分公司' WHEN 'F1003' THEN '南山分公司'
     WHEN 'F1007' THEN '宝安水务集团' WHEN 'F1501' THEN '龙岗水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1500' THEN '龙华水务集团' WHEN 'F1005' THEN '光明水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1012' THEN '大鹏新区分公司' WHEN 'F1014' THEN '布吉水司'
     WHEN 'F1013' THEN '莲塘供水' WHEN 'F1009' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN 'F1011' THEN '深汕水务'
     ELSE f.zoneid END AS "组织", c.rate AS rate_2026, y.rate AS rate_2025, c.rate - y.rate AS yoy_change
FROM (
  SELECT f.zoneid, (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
  WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth=CAST(202606 AS int)
  GROUP BY f.zoneid
) c
JOIN (
  SELECT f.zoneid, (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
  WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth=CAST(202606 AS int)-100
  GROUP BY f.zoneid
) y ON c.zoneid=y.zoneid
JOIN dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f ON f.zoneid=c.zoneid
 AND f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth=CAST(202606 AS int)
GROUP BY c.zoneid, c.rate, y.rate, f.zoneid
ORDER BY yoy_change ASC NULLS LAST, 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY "同比变化" ASC NULLS LAST, 1 ASC
evidence: 使用 year_cum_diff_rate 的 202606 与 202506 两期值相减

results.question: 列出各单位2026年6月单月产销差率和2026年7月检漏工单数量。
results.actual_text: 单月率 15 个单位；检漏工单数不可取
results.sql:
SELECT _g."组织" AS "组织", ROUND((_g.rate)::numeric, 4) AS "单月产销差率", CAST(_g.detect_cnt AS bigint) AS "检漏工单数"
FROM (
SELECT COALESCE(r."组织", o."组织") AS "组织", r.rate AS rate, COALESCE(o.cnt, 0) AS detect_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT 
CASE f.zoneid WHEN 'F1' THEN '深圳环境水务集团'
     WHEN 'F100' THEN '集团本部'
     WHEN 'F1001' THEN '盐田分公司'
     WHEN 'F1002' THEN '罗湖分公司' WHEN 'F1004' THEN '福田分公司' WHEN 'F1003' THEN '南山分公司'
     WHEN 'F1007' THEN '宝安水务集团' WHEN 'F1501' THEN '龙岗水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1500' THEN '龙华水务集团' WHEN 'F1005' THEN '光明水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1012' THEN '大鹏新区分公司' WHEN 'F1014' THEN '布吉水司'
     WHEN 'F1013' THEN '莲塘供水' WHEN 'F1009' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN 'F1011' THEN '深汕水务'
     ELSE f.zoneid END AS "组织", (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate
  FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
  WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusiness' AND f.businessyearmonth=CAST(202606 AS int)
  GROUP BY f.zoneid
) r
FULL JOIN (
  SELECT CASE bz_bm WHEN '坪地分公司' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN '莲塘分公司' THEN '莲塘供水'
     ELSE bz_bm END AS "组织", COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM dwd_gdgl_gd_jlmx
  WHERE create_time>=CAST('2026-06-01' AS date) + INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND create_time<CAST('2026-06-01' AS date) + INTERVAL '2 months'
  GROUP BY 1
) o ON r."组织" = o."组织"
ORDER BY rate DESC NULLS LAST, 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY "单月产销差率" DESC NULLS LAST, 1 ASC

results.question: 上月夜间小流量预警频次最高的前10个小区 DMA 分别是哪些？列出编码、名称、单位和预警次数。
results.sql:
SELECT _g."DMA编码" AS "DMA编码", _g."DMA名称" AS "DMA名称", _g."组织" AS "组织", CAST(_g.cnt AS bigint) AS "预警次数"
FROM (
SELECT dmaid AS "DMA编码", MAX(dmaname) AS "DMA名称", CASE
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1014%%' THEN '布吉水司'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1013%%' THEN '莲塘供水'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1009%%' THEN '坪地供水'
    ELSE bz_bm
END AS "组织", COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM dwd_lsxt_bj
WHERE srctype='NightFlow' AND warndate::date>=CAST('2026-07-01' AS date) AND warndate::date<CAST('2026-08-01' AS date) AND dmaid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY dmaid, CASE
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1014%%' THEN '布吉水司'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1013%%' THEN '莲塘供水'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1009%%' THEN '坪地供水'
    ELSE bz_bm
END
ORDER BY cnt DESC, dmaid ASC
LIMIT 10
) _g
ORDER BY "预警次数" DESC

results.question: 上月产生的漏损预警中，预警总数、未处理数和超过10天未处理数分别是多少？
results.sql:
SELECT CAST(_g.total_cnt AS bigint) AS "预警总数", CAST(_g.unhandled_cnt AS bigint) AS "未处理数", CAST(_g.overdue_cnt AS bigint) AS "超时未处理数"
FROM (
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT handled) AS unhandled_cnt,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT handled
              AND warndate::date < CAST('2026-07-31' AS date) - 10) AS overdue_cnt
FROM dwd_lsxt_bj
WHERE warndate::date>=CAST('2026-07-01' AS date) AND warndate::date<CAST('2026-08-01' AS date)
) _g

results.question: 按管径分段列出上月爆管事件在各单位的发生情况，并下钻到三级部门。
results.sql:
SELECT _g."管径分段" AS "管径分段", _g."组织" AS "组织", _g."三级部门" AS "三级部门", CAST(_g.cnt AS bigint) AS "爆管次数"
FROM (
SELECT seg AS "管径分段", "组织", MAX(level3) AS "三级部门", COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN NULLIF(caliber,'')::numeric IS NULL THEN '未知'
              WHEN NULLIF(caliber,'')::numeric>=1000 THEN '1000毫米及以上'
              WHEN NULLIF(caliber,'')::numeric>=600 THEN '600至不足1000'
              WHEN NULLIF(caliber,'')::numeric>=400 THEN '400至不足600'
              ELSE '不足400' END AS seg,
         CASE bz_bm WHEN '坪地分公司' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN '莲塘分公司' THEN '莲塘供水'
     ELSE bz_bm END AS "组织", level3_name AS level3
  FROM dwd_gdgl_gd_gsgdwxmx
  WHERE create_time>=CAST('2026-07-01' AS timestamp) AND create_time<CAST('2026-08-01' AS timestamp) AND (accident_type LIKE '%%爆%%' OR flow_status_name LIKE '%%爆管%%')
) t
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1 ASC, cnt DESC
) _g
ORDER BY 1 ASC, "爆管次数" DESC

FROM (
SELECT CASE
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1014%%' THEN '布吉水司'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1013%%' THEN '莲塘供水'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1009%%' THEN '坪地供水'
    ELSE bz_bm
END AS "组织", COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(*)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (),0) AS share
FROM dwd_lsxt_dma
WHERE status='WORK'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY cnt DESC, 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY "DMA数" DESC, 1 ASC

results.question: 各单位2026年6月的DMA漏损量、DMA小区数及上半年产销差率分别是多少？
results.actual_text: 率 15 个单位可对；漏损量/小区数不可取
results.sql:
SELECT _g."组织" AS "组织", ROUND((_g.rate)::numeric, 4) AS "累计产销差率", ROUND((_g.loss_vol)::numeric, 4) AS "DMA漏损量", CAST(_g.dma_cnt AS bigint) AS "DMA小区数"
FROM (
SELECT COALESCE(w."组织", r."组织") AS "组织", r.rate AS rate,
       w.loss_vol AS loss_vol, w.dma_cnt AS dma_cnt
FROM (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1014%%' THEN '布吉水司'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1013%%' THEN '莲塘供水'
    WHEN bz_bm = '其他' AND zonecode LIKE '%%F1009%%' THEN '坪地供水'
    ELSE bz_bm
END AS "组织", SUM(w.physicalloss) AS loss_vol, COUNT(DISTINCT w.dmaid) AS dma_cnt
  FROM dwd_lsxt_wlls w
  WHERE periodtype='Day' AND diffresult='GOOD' AND w.taskstart::date >= CAST('2026-06-01' AS date)
    AND w.taskstart::date <= CAST('2026-06-30' AS date)
  GROUP BY 1
) w
FULL JOIN (
  SELECT 
CASE f.zoneid WHEN 'F1' THEN '深圳环境水务集团'
     WHEN 'F100' THEN '集团本部'
     WHEN 'F1001' THEN '盐田分公司'
     WHEN 'F1002' THEN '罗湖分公司' WHEN 'F1004' THEN '福田分公司' WHEN 'F1003' THEN '南山分公司'
     WHEN 'F1007' THEN '宝安水务集团' WHEN 'F1501' THEN '龙岗水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1500' THEN '龙华水务集团' WHEN 'F1005' THEN '光明水务集团'
     WHEN 'F1012' THEN '大鹏新区分公司' WHEN 'F1014' THEN '布吉水司'
     WHEN 'F1013' THEN '莲塘供水' WHEN 'F1009' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN 'F1011' THEN '深汕水务'
     ELSE f.zoneid END AS "组织", (SUM(f.totalproduct)-SUM(f.totalconsume))/NULLIF(SUM(f.totalproduct),0) AS rate
  FROM dwd_lsxt_fqcxfx f
  WHERE f.periodtype='SzwgBusinessYear' AND f.businessyearmonth=CAST(202606 AS int)
  GROUP BY f.zoneid
) r ON w."组织" = r."组织"
ORDER BY loss_vol DESC NULLS LAST, 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY "DMA漏损量" DESC NULLS LAST, 1 ASC
results.root_cause: 累计产销差率可由 year_cum_diff_rate 直接对应；DMA 漏损量在标准值里来自 dwd_lsxt_wlls.physicalloss（diffresult='GOOD'），DMA 小区数是该表去重 dmaid 数。CLI 没有 wlls/physicalloss 对应命令：month_loss_water 是总漏损量（福田 1,390,993 vs 标准 484,990），month_physical_leakage_amount 是日粒度 2,134 行，均不能直接替代。
results.recommendation: 新增一个按组织聚合的 DMA 物理漏损命令（SUM(physicalloss) + COUNT(DISTINCT dmaid)），或在 leakage_analysis_information 暴露可对齐 wlls 的字段；否则该题只能核对产销差率一列。
evidence: 累计产销差率来自 year_cum_diff_rate 202606
month_loss_water 202606 福田 1,390,993 → 标准 DMA漏损量 484,990
month_physical_leakage_amount 返回 2,134 行日粒度数据

results.sql:
SELECT _g."管道编码" AS "管道编码", _g."组织" AS "组织", _g."地址" AS "地址", CAST(_g.cnt AS bigint) AS "维修次数"
FROM (
SELECT pipe_number AS "管道编码", CASE bz_bm WHEN '坪地分公司' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN '莲塘分公司' THEN '莲塘供水'
     ELSE bz_bm END AS "组织", MAX(detailedaddress) AS "地址", COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM dwd_gdgl_gd_gsgdwxmx
WHERE create_time>=CAST('2026-01-01' AS timestamp) AND create_time<CAST('2026-08-18' AS timestamp) AND pipe_number IS NOT NULL AND pipe_number<>''
GROUP BY pipe_number, CASE bz_bm WHEN '坪地分公司' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN '莲塘分公司' THEN '莲塘供水'
     ELSE bz_bm END
HAVING COUNT(*) > 2
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pipe_number ASC
) _g
ORDER BY "维修次数" DESC

results.recommendation: 改短命令码；如果要做「全年反复维修」，还要确认 create_time 的年初边界和设施编码字段名（标准值用 dwd_gdgl_gd_gsgdwxmx 的设施编码）。 另外，该题需要字段：设施编码、bz_bm、地址、create_time，且需按设施编码分组计数；改短命令码后请一并确认这些字段已返回。
